This Ordinance is enacted pursuant to the provisions of the New Local Government Code, RA 7160 Sections 458 a.2 (7-9) and 447 a.2 (7-9) dated 10 October 1991, “Authorizing the Municipality through the Sangguniang Bayan to adopt Zoning Ordinance subject to the provisions of existing laws, and in conformity with E.O No. 72.
- 1. Agricultural Zone (AGZ) - An area WITHIN A MUNICIPALITY INTENDED for cultivation/fishing and pastoral activities e.g. fish, farming, cultivation of crops, goat/cattle raising, etc.

- 3. Buffer Area - Are YARDS, PARKS OR open spaces INTENDED to separate incompatible elements or uses to control pollution/nuisance and for identifying and for defining development areas or zones where NO PERMANENT STRUCTURES ARE ALLOWED.
- 11. Easement – Open space imposed on any land use/activities sited along waterways, National Roads Barangay Roads road-right–of ways, cemeteries/memorial parks and utilities.
